rules.name: Requirements Overivew
rules.notes:
At least 20 out of the 35 units for the minor must be taken at Stanford. Students must have completed all Stanford prerequisites for approved transfer credit courses to use those courses toward the Economics minor.
No courses receiving Department of Economics credit under the preceding requirements may be taken credit/no credit. The combined total of all minor units must equal the grade point average (GPA) of 2.0 (C) or better.

rules.name: Core Courses - Complete for a total of 20 units
Field Courses - Complete for a total of 10 units
rules.notes:
• Students may only count units from ECON 135, ECON 140, or ECON 141 toward their minor as the courses are too similar in content.

• Students may not count units from ECON 160, ECON 167G, and ECON 180 toward their minor as the courses cover similar subject matter.

• For ECON 202 or ECON 210, students may enroll with the permission of the Director of Undergraduate Studies and the course instructor.

rules.name: Electives (at least 5 units)
rules.desc: Complete a total of five units, selecting from any ECON courses offered for letter grades. Students who receive approval to waive course must complete another 5 units of electives to make up for the waived units. Students who complete 2 Field courses with a combined unit total of less than 10 units must also complete more units of electives to satisfy the 35 unit requirement.
